title: Sehil mo ɓuuɓnataa e nder ñaawoore kaŋŋe
intro: E nder 6uu6ol annabi mawcfo, ruuhu 6urcfo haalde e googcfinal su6aama ngam wallude e golle mawcfe. Ndeeɗoo limoore dariima nde jamaanu nguu ƴaañii, ina waajoo e fenaande laaɓtunde, hulɓiniinde e nder hoore diine ngootaagu. Nde annabi oo arti seedtaade lappol yim6e ngol, ndee limre ndee wonaani e aybinde kono ko e dow doole e kulol feccere. Hol oo maccuɗo Alla dewɗo ?
clues: Mi suɓaama e Alla ngam gollal ceniingal e bannge goɗɗo, darnde am ko ballal e bayyinaango.
Mi rokkaama laaɓal haala, mi yahdi e nulaaɗo ngam haɓaade tooñoowo doole.
E nder njillu tiiɗngu, nulaaɗo oo ƴetti koɗorɗe tan, acci mi ina ndaara yimɓe ɓee.
E nder ŋakkeende maɓɓe, yimɓe ɓee peewni natal kaŋŋe, miɗo ñaagii ɓe nde ɓe ngonata e gooŋɗinde, kono ɓe njaɓaani wasiya am.
Nde nulaaɗo oo arti, ina heewi tikkere e sunaare, mi nanngaa, kono mi faamnii mi wonde mi fooliima, mi hulii saabaade luural hakkunde maɓɓe.
Ko miin woni annabi darinooɗo sara Muusaa, miñi am, renndinde ɗum teddeendi e heddoraade tiiɗnaare e rewde sanamuuji.

trial.label: Ñaawoore/Kewu
options: Yimɓe ina ndewatnoo nagge kaŋŋe hay so jeertinaama
Yimɓe mberlii kam e yiite wulnge
Mi riiwaama wuro am ngam waajaade
trial.answer: Yimɓe ina ndewatnoo nagge kaŋŋe hay so jeertinaama

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Mi woppitaama, mi jokki e golle am annabaagal
Mi ɗonno ƴama ngam aybe yimɓe
Mi hokkaama leñol kesol ngam ardaade
Mi hootaama haa asama mi wuuri
outcome.answer: Mi woppitaama, mi jokki e golle am annabaagal

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَجَعَلْنَا مَعَهُۥٓ أَخَاهُ هَـٰرُونَ وَزِيرًۭا
verse: And We had certainly given Moses the Scripture and appointed with him his brother Aaron as an assistant. (25:35)
